sloka: विभीषणस्तु धर्मात्मा नित्यं धर्मे व्यवस्थितः ।स्वाध्यायनियताहार उवास विजितेन्द्रियः ।। ७.९.३९ ॥
transliteration: vibhīṣaṇastu dharmātmā nityaṁ dharme vyavasthitaḥ ।svādhyāyaniyatāhāra uvāsa vijitendriyaḥ ।। 7.9.39 ॥

translations.english: In contrast, Vibhishana, a righteous soul, always remained steadfast in dharma, living with self-study, a controlled diet, and mastery over his senses.
